name: Battle Live! School of Idols
source:
Welcome to Pride Park! The school that fosters upcoming idols to take to the stage. 

The two halves of the school (girl's and boy's) battle each other in live performances known as Battle Lives for recognition and marks. Split into idol groups known as units, they perform their hearts out onstage. 

Considering all this, transfering to a school like this would clearly be an exciting new thrill!

...right?

[From [url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/battle-live] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到骄傲公园！这是一所培养未来偶像、让他们登上舞台的学校。

学校分为男女两部分，双方通过名为Battle Live的现场演出互相竞争，争夺认可与成绩。他们分成称作“组合”的偶像团体，在舞台上倾尽全力表演。

考虑到这些，转学到这样的学校显然会是一种令人兴奋的新体验！

……对吧？

（来源：[url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/battle-live]itch.io[/url]）
